headline: Crude Benchmarks Eye Fourth Monthly Gain Despite Gulf Flows
summary: Oil benchmarks are heading for their fourth consecutive monthly gain, showing resilience despite reports that Gulf nations have boosted oil exports and flows through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to pre-war levels.
why: Crude oil is a primary driver of global inflation benchmarks and transportation input costs. Sustained price gains impact central bank policy trajectories and operational margins across global energy and industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Crude benchmarks are set for their fourth straight monthly gain despite supply recovery through the Strait of Hormuz.
